newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta Pipeline Project seeks gas shippers.
newsitem.headline: Alberta Pipeline Project seeks gas shippers.

text.p: Backers of the proposed Alberta Pipeline Project, which would compete with NOVA Corp on its now-exclusive turf, said on Tuesday they would ask potential shippers to subscribe for pipeline capacity in an open season.

"We're offering a competitive transportation alternative that will provide shippers with cost-certainty. The open season will enable all gas shippers to contract for capacity at competitive rates," project leader Larry Graburn said in a statement.
The project, whose partners include ATCO Ltd and Shell Canada Ltd, would ship 1.2 billion cubic feet of gas to the Alberta-Saskatchewan border from inside Alberta starting in late 1999.
Mobil Corp unit Mobil Oil Canada and Amoco Corp unit Amoco Canada Petroleum Co Ltd have said they would be major shippers on the system.
Project officials have said they would file their application with Canada's National Energy Board after the open season. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
